patient_actor_hidden.History: Patient reports sudden, painless loss of vision in her right eye that occurred about 30 minutes ago. She mentions the episode happened while she was watching TV. On further questioning, she reports a history of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes mellitus. She admits to not always adhering to her prescribed medication regimen.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Sudden, painless loss of vision in the right eye
Secondary_Symptoms: No changes in vision in the left eye
No recent history of eye trauma

patient_actor_hidden.Past_Medical_History: Coronary artery disease, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus.
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Patient lives alone and is recently retired. She smokes 10 cigarettes a day and drinks alcohol occasionally.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies recent headache, dizziness, chest pain, or difficulty breathing.

objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a patient presenting with sudden, unilateral loss of vision.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor, I’m a 60-year-old woman, and about 30 minutes ago I had a sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye while I was watching TV. It hasn’t affected my left eye, and there’s no eye pain or recent injury.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I haven’t noticed any yellowing of my skin or the whites of my eyes. My right vision just suddenly went away, painless, and the left eye feels normal.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel stiffness in your joints or muscles when you wake up in the morning?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I don’t feel stiffness in my joints or muscles when I wake up, and I haven’t noticed any unusual weakness or pain in my arms or legs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling confused lately—like you’re having trouble thinking clearly, staying oriented, or understanding what’s going on?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t been confused, and I feel clear-minded and oriented—I understand what’s happening and I don’t have trouble thinking.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been having **night sweats**—waking up with your clothes or bedding noticeably damp—at least a few nights recently?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t had any night sweats or woken up with damp bedding or clothes. The only problem is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump or swelling in your thigh that feels like it’s within the muscle (not just on the skin)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any lump or swelling in my thigh, and I don’t feel anything tender or firm within the muscle. My only concern right now is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any skin lesions, sores, or unusual bumps along the veins on your arm (for example, in a line or track where a vein runs)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I haven’t noticed any skin lesions, sores, or unusual bumps along the veins on my arm—nothing in a line or track along a vein. It’s only the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that concerns me right now.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever worked in a job where you might breathe in metal dust or metal fumes—for example welding, grinding, cutting, machining, construction/renovation with metal, battery work, or working with metal powders?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t worked with welding or metal dust/fumes, and I haven’t done any metal cutting or machining or battery work. I mainly live independently and don’t have that kind of exposure.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around your joints (for example, fingers, knuckles, knees, or hips), such as bumps that seem to be part of the bone rather than just soft swelling?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t noticed any bony enlargement or swelling around my joints—my fingers, knuckles, knees, and hips look normal to me.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you currently have pain in your thigh (either one or both thighs)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I don’t have any pain in my thigh—either one or both. My only issue is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that began about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this—can I ask: **do you experience pain or discomfort during sex (either at the start or deeper inside)?**
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I don’t have pain or discomfort during sex, either at the start or deeper inside. My only problem is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any scattered skin lesions—like small bumps, spots, or sores—appearing in different areas of your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor, I haven’t noticed any scattered skin lesions, small bumps, spots, or sores anywhere on my body. My only symptom is the sudden, painless loss of vision in my right eye that started about 30 minutes ago.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that you (or the person you’re caring for) seem unusually restless, irritable, or unable to stay calm—more than usual?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor. I haven’t felt unusually restless, irritable, or unable to stay calm—I’m not acting more agitated than usual, and I can sit and talk with you normally.”

turns.doctor_question: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. **Are you having chest pain right now** (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I’m not having chest pain right now.”
